title: podostemum pterophyllum
intro: Podostemum pterophyllum, commonly known as the "Duckweed", is a floating aquatic plant that belongs to the Podostemaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include lowering cholesterol levels, improving blood lipid profiles, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Podostemum pterophyllum are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
